bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,pathlib,sys
p=subprocess.run(['docker','inspect','deploy-gaybbs-1','--format','{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=12)
if p.returncode:sys.exit(61)
paths=[x.strip() for x in p.stdout.strip().split(',') if x.strip()]
if not 1<=len(paths)<=5:sys.exit(62)
mask=sum(1<<i for i,x in enumerate(paths) if not pathlib.Path(x).is_file())
sys.exit(120+len(paths)*20+mask)
PY
